MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

4. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 2.5

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 4

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 1
   D. 57

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

13. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

15. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

18. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

19. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

20. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

21. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 11

23. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 15
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
